title.value: Bisimulation metrics and norms for real-weighted automata
title.justification: The title succinctly captures the core focus of the paper, which is about developing bisimulation metrics for weighted finite automata, a computational model.
title.quote: Bisimulation metrics and norms for real-weighted automata

extractions.description: The paper introduces a new bisimulation (pseudo)metric for weighted finite automata (WFA), generalizing Boreale’s linear bisimulation relation. These metrics are based on the spectral properties of linear operators and joint spectral radii of WFA transition matrices. The study includes continuity properties, an undecidability result for metric computation, and preliminary applications to spectral learning.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is focused on mathematical and computational theories related to bisimulation metrics in automata and doesn’t focus on Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We develop a new bisimulation (pseudo)metric for weighted finite automata (WFA) that generalizes Boreale’s linear bisimulation relation.
